feature: Reset administration fee dan amount_payable ke composition saat notice di-redirect ke DN1/RD1 lewat furnish (OCMS-DF-2026-170)
note: Setiap jalur approve furnish (auto di FurnishApprovalHelper, staff di StaffFurnishService, manual review di ManualReviewService) mengosongkan administration_fee dan mengembalikan amount_payable ke composition_amount supaya fee RR3/DR3 tidak ikut ke pihak baru. Dipakai OCMS12.36 tetapi tidak ada di story manapun yang diberikan. Apakah ada story lain yang menaunginya belum dicek.
note_en: Every furnish approval path (auto in FurnishApprovalHelper, staff in StaffFurnishService, manual review in ManualReviewService) clears administration_fee and resets amount_payable to composition_amount so that the RR3/DR3 fee does not follow to the new party. Used by OCMS12.36 but not in any story given. Whether another story covers it has not been checked.
